_: THE SWITCHYARD — nest_2. Re-run with: tools/shot.sh --seq=tools/seq/nest_2.json
Twelve captures. Four screens, and every door that matters photographed in
__: BOTH of its states, because the whole subject of this level is that one
___: tile means two things: gold solid is a wall and gold ghost is a doorway,
____: and which one you are looking at is the only question the level asks.
_____: The pairs are (b,m) the signal box, (c,h) the gantry east, (d,e) sigma,
______: (d,f) beta. Nothing here is staged: the switches are thrown by walking
_______: into them, exactly as the player does.

_: GOTCHAS, each of them paid for at least once in this project:
__: * a bare {"settle": n} is a no-op — settle is a MODIFIER on scenario and
___: teleport, and {"wait": n} is the standalone one.
____: * teleport puts the TOP-LEFT of a 22 px body on the tile's top-left, so her
_____: feet land 6 px into the row below: aim at the stand row over SOLID floor,
______: and one row ABOVE a nest_ledge, which she would otherwise be standing
_______: inside and fall through. Both levers here are on ledges, so both throws
________: below aim at row-1 and let her drop the last tile onto the tread.
_________: * teleporting onto the exit tile completes the level and the capture lands
__________: on the hub — so the last shot stands in the vestibule at (11,13), seven
___________: tiles east of the exit, with both of the doors it is about in frame.
____________: * SwitchTrigger.toggle() has a 0.45 s cooldown and fires on OVERLAP, so a
_____________: body left standing on a lever throws it again 27 frames later. Every
______________: throw below is teleport, wait 20, teleport away — one flip, on purpose.
_______________: * settle 210 on the first scenario: the level-title card is still up at 90

_: SCREEN C (cols 0-24, rows 15-29) — THE WEST HALL, at spawn.
__: Ten rows of black glass with a nest_chain hanging down the middle of it:
___: the lift, at col 15, which goes to the gantry and to the level's exit and
____: which she will not use for another three minutes. Group 1 is ON and group
_____: 2 is OFF — TileWorld's defaults — so this is the level as it ships.

_: SCREEN A (cols 0-24, rows 0-14) — THE SIGNAL BOX, SHUT. The top of the
__: lift, and the two doors between it and the way out: Q at col 13 is
___: switch_block_a_on and P at col 9 is switch_block_b_off, so at spawn BOTH
____: are solid — one gold wall and one magenta wall, four tiles apart, eleven
_____: tiles tall. G3 at col 17 is the gold GHOST on the other side of her: the
______: same group as Q and the opposite half of it, which is the whole trick.

_: SCREEN B (cols 25-49, rows 0-14) — THE GANTRY EAST, SHUT. G1 at col 38 is
__: gold-solid and G2 at col 26 is magenta-solid, with chute M's two-tile hole
___: in the floor at cols 34-35 between them. Nothing here is passable yet and
____: nothing here can be changed from here: both levers are a screen and a
_____: chain away, which is the level's actual difficulty. Compare with shot h.

_: SCREEN D (cols 25-49, rows 15-29) — THE CABIN. The one frame this level
__: is designed around: switch_a on the lower tread at (29,25), switch_b on
___: the upper one at (30,18), the chain between them, beta at col 26 (magenta
____: GHOST — open, the way she came in) and sigma at col 37 (gold SOLID — shut,
_____: the way on). Two levers and two of the six doors they move, at a glance.

_: THROW A. Aimed one row above the tread so she drops the last tile onto it
__: rather than standing inside it; twenty frames is one flip and well inside

_: SIGMA IS OPEN. Same camera, same tile, one throw later: the gold column at
__: col 37 is a ghost. Two screens away the same throw opened G1 and SHUT G3,
___: and she cannot see either of those — that is what this level costs.

_: THROW B. beta SHUTS: the magenta column at col 26 goes solid and the yard
__: floor she walked in along is gone. It is the level's commitment gate and
___: it is deliberately the one thing a throw does that she IS looking at.

_: THE SIDING, open. Looking east along the deck the gold throw opened: the
__: ghost at col 37 is sigma, and the one-tile hole at col 42 is chute E, the
___: drain that means this deck can never seal anyone in. Both are in the same
____: screen as the levers that decide them.

_: SCREEN B again — THE GANTRY EAST, OPEN. The identical framing as shot c,
__: with both plugs now ghosts: gold G1 because of the throw at the lower
___: tread, magenta G2 because of the throw at the upper one. This is the
____: before/after the level's whole argument rests on.

_: SCREEN A — G3, AND WHY THE GANTRY CANNOT BE WALKED. Standing west of G2
__: with both throws made: the gold column at col 17 is SOLID, because G3 is
___: switch_block_a_off and the throw that opened G1 is the throw that shut
____: this. No configuration opens both. The two-tile hole at cols 21-22 in
_____: front of her is chute W, and it is the way on.

_: THE DROP, caught in the air: thirteen rows down chute W into the hall she
__: started in. Dropped in over the hole rather than walked into it, because
___: the first version of this shot held move_left off the lip at (23,13) and
____: what the capture caught was the pocket's guard knocking her back onto the
_____: gantry -- which is how that enemy became a flyer. Sixteen frames puts her
______: past the seam at y=240: at settle 16 her centre was still 5 px above
_______: it and the capture landed on the gantry's screen; at 26 she was on the
________: top edge of the hall's. 34 puts her two rows down the shaft, in frame.

_: SCREEN C — THE LIFT, climbed. The chain at col 15 seen from halfway up,
__: with the hall's floor below and the shaft cut through four rows of glass
___: above. This is the same chain that was in shot a, three minutes later,
____: and the only reason the level's ending is where its beginning was.

_: SCREEN A — THE SIGNAL BOX, OPEN, and the shot that pairs with b. Standing
__: in the vestibule between the two last doors: Q at col 13 is a gold ghost
___: because group 1 is OFF and P at col 9 is a magenta ghost because group 2
____: is ON. The exit is seven tiles west of her and the level is a machine
_____: that has been set to let her through it.
